title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!
At Eleven , we thrive on solving complex challenges and pushing boundaries. We work at a rapid pace, embracing change, and staying laser-focused on delivering exceptional value to our customers.
We’re looking for visionary problem-solvers who excel in dynamic environments, embrace AI tools in streamlining work processes, adapt quickly, and drive innovation. If you love thinking outside the box, collaborating with top-tier talent, and having fun while making an impact-let’s talk!
Position Overview:
This role is a dual-focus technical leadership position within our Engineering organization: leading company-wide AI productivity initiatives and contributing as a senior software engineer to our core product. You will design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate delivery and raise quality across engineering and other departments. You will develop and execute training strategies that bring all employees along in adopting AI effectively and securely. This role contributes to a globally distributed SaaS platform used around the world to effortlessly and securely connect guests and residents (and all their devices) to the internet with an at-home Wi-Fi experience. Our platform serves a variety of markets. From hotels and multi-family residences to campgrounds and college campuses, every day, tens of millions of people benefit from the services we provide.
As a Senior AI Engineer, you will stay at the cutting edge of AI technology, evaluate and introduce new tools and patterns to the organization, champion security-first practices in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, and continue to contribute hands-on to the development of our cloud-native platform.
Reporting Relationships:
This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager and has no direct reports. Provides AI and technical leadership across all engineering teams and partners with other departments on AI adoption initiatives.

AI Leadership & Productivity

• Develop and execute AI training strategies and enablement programs for employees across the organization, ensuring teams can effectively and responsibly adopt AI tools

• Manage AI-related vendor and tech partner relationships, evaluating tools and platforms for fit, security, and cost-effectiveness

• Drive end-to-end solution ownership-from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and operational excellence

• Mentor and develop engineers at all levels, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation

title: Mental Health Therapist - Tennessee
description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC-MHSP, LMFT, LCSW) in Tennessee to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

title: Contract Writer - A Book Exploring the Beauty and Meaning of Sacred Art
description:
Location: Remote
Position Overview
We are seeking a contract writer to develop a theologically grounded, highly visual book exploring sacred art-past or present-that helps readers engage both its beauty and its theological depth. This project should integrate compelling visuals with thoughtful, accessible commentary that invites reflection, worship, and deeper understanding. It could take the form of a trade book, coffee table book, or something else. The strongest proposals will clearly define the reader and demonstrate how the visual and written elements will work together to explore the beauty and meaning of sacred art.
Scope of Work

• Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000-75,000 words)

• Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision

• Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co. ’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment
Contract, per-project basis.
Compensation
Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.
Additional Information
Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.
Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co. ?
With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books-but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.
Proposal Requirements

Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.
Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:
1. Title and Subtitle
2. Controlling Idea (1-2 sentences)
3. One-Paragraph Summary
Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.
4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

• Their stage or season of life

• The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing

• Why this book matters to them now

• Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2-3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2-3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

• How your book overlaps with each one

• How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio
Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

• Education

• Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience

• Subject-matter expertise

• Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)

• Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline
Provide a working table of contents that includes:

• Chapter titles

• The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

• Please ensure a list of the pieces of art that you would like to include is part of the detailed outline

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)
Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).
9. Timeline and Specifications
Include:

• Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)

• Estimated total word count (typically 45,000-75,000 words)

• Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)
If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co. , please include a brief description of each idea (1-3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future pu

description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. • Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

We're looking for a detail-oriented freelance Learning Content Reviewer to make sure our French content is accurate, natural and genuinely useful, so learners pick up French the way it's really spoken and written. This is a freelance role, paid hourly.

Speed, precision and quality are how we work. You'll review content as it's created, including content produced with the help of AI, and help us catch what machines miss. Your feedback will directly shape what learners experience and how our curriculum grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review learning content across formats. Check text, audio and images for accuracy, clarity, naturalness and consistency, and flag anything that could confuse or mislead a learner.

- Ensure French content is authentic and current. Check grammar, spelling, register (tu vs. vous), idioms and cultural references, and make sure audio reflects natural French pronunciation.

- Quality-check AI-generated content. Evaluate content created with AI tools, identify recurring errors and help us improve how that content is produced.

- Give clear, actionable feedback. Document issues and suggestions in a way that content creators, linguists and engineers can act on quickly.

- Help raise the quality bar. Contribute to review guidelines, style standards and checklists that keep content consistent at scale.

- Work across disciplines with product managers, linguists, learning content strategists and engineers.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in at least one of the following: proofreading, translation, language teaching, or learning content quality testing.

- Language skills. Native or near-native French, plus fluent English. Excellent oral and written communication skills in both.

- A sharp eye for detail. You notice the small things, from a mistranslated word to an audio clip that doesn't match its transcript.

- A learner-first mindset. You understand what makes content clear and motivating for someone learning a new language.

- Comfort with AI tools. You're curious about how AI is changing content creation and happy to use it as part of your workflow.

- Reliability and independence. You manage your own time, meet deadlines and communicate proactively when something needs attention.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You're happy working in a fast-changing environment where processes evolve as we learn.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- A consumer product used around the world. Your reviews directly improve a live product that real learners use every day, globally.

- Meaningful impact. Your feedback shapes the content and curriculum, not just the final polish.

- Competitive hourly rate. Pay that reflects your experience and the quality of your work.

Wolt's Shared Service Center in Budapest is home to a team of 40 people who keep our operations running across markets. Ten of them focus on one mission: getting German merchants to live on Wolt quickly and correctly. description:
About BJAK
BJAK was founded on a simple belief: people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. That is where our name comes from.

We started in 2019 by building the region's first mobile-first insurance platform, making insurance accessible online to millions. Today we are Southeast Asia's leading insurance platform, and we are expanding into everything else people do with their money - spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling.

Our teams span more than 20 nationalities across our offices and remotely. We look for people who work for the thing itself rather than the hours, who want to build the next generation of products rather than maintain the current one, and who care about getting great financial tools into everyone's hands rather than a select few.

If that sounds like you, we would like to talk.

The role
You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

This is a broad role in a new market. Some weeks will be partnership negotiation, others will be regulatory groundwork, operational setup, or working out why something is not converting. We are looking for someone comfortable moving between all of it rather than a specialist in any one part.
What you will do
Partnerships

• Identify, approach and close partnerships with financial institutions and ecosystem players

• Own each relationship end to end, from first conversation through negotiation, onboarding, integration and go-live

• Lead commercial negotiations, with sound judgement on pricing and partnership economics

• Keep a visible pipeline, with disciplined follow-up and clear reporting

• Work with legal, product, technology and compliance to get agreements live quickly

Get the market working

• Establish how we operate locally, including the regulatory requirements that apply to us

• Work with external counsel and internal compliance on the policies we need in place as we grow

• Act as a primary point of contact for regulators and manage filings and communications

• Own monthly revenue, volume and activation targets, and drive partner productivity after go-live

Strategy and operations

• Set the local strategy - which segments we go after, which partners matter most, where we compete and where we do not

• Build the operating rhythm behind it, from reporting and planning through to the processes the team runs on

• Feed what you learn locally into our wider regional and global strategy, and bring the global playbook back into the local market

• Work with teams across the group, taking what has already worked elsewhere rather than rebuilding from scratch

What we are looking for

• Fluent Indonesian and English, written and spoken

• At least five years across technology, financial services or a comparable commercial environment, with real negotiation and partnership experience

• A generalist who has operated across functions - you have done commercial work, but also picked up operations, regulatory, product or whatever else the situation needed

• Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and willing to do both in the same week

• Evidence of building something from nothing, whether a market, a function or a business line

• Comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed. We expect initiative rather than instruction, and this role will not suit someone who needs to be nudged or handheld

W  T&P  łączymy kreatywność, technologię i media, by dostarczać naszym Klientom kompleksowe rozwiązania komunikacyjne. Nasza przedsiębiorcza struktura działa w 45 biurach na czterech kontynentach.

The data behind a model shapes it more than almost anything else. On the RL Data team at SpaceXAI, you decide what that data is for our agents: which problems they practice, what world they practice in, and how they're judged. You'll take a weakness, like an agent that gives up on hard bugs or misuses a calendar API, and turn it into training data that fixes it, then show the next model is measurably better.

You form hypotheses about why data is helping or misleading the model, build the systems to test them, run ablations, and read the rollouts to find the bug, shortcut or mismatch behind a result. Every flaw you catch, or miss, shows up in what the next Grok models learn.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

- Turning a capability gap into thousands of verifiable tasks - for example, planting subtle bugs deep in a real project's dependencies for the agent to root-cause.

- Building environments that behave like production: real codebases with their real dependencies, and simulations of apps like email, calendar, and docs that match the real ones down to search, errors, and pagination.

- Designing graders for open-ended work that separate good solutions from bad without penalizing valid alternatives or rewarding shortcuts.

- Building automated checks that catch reward hacking, leaked answers, broken environments, and paths the real product wouldn't allow, before data reaches training.

- Scaling from a thousand hand-checked tasks to millions, with filters and judges you can trust in place of a person reading each one

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have strong software engineering fundamentals, and you've built non-trivial systems in Python: data pipelines, test or eval infrastructure, sandboxes, or backend services.

- You have taste for what makes an environment trustworthy: faithful enough that skills transfer, strict enough that shortcuts fail, and simple enough to debug when a result looks wrong.

- You are careful and systematic - understanding both aggregate metrics and close reading of raw outputs.

- You enjoy turning messy, open-ended problems into repeatable, high-quality data production systems.

- RL or ML experience is a plus but not required. We welcome strong engineers who want to do research on what makes models better.

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure)
description:
About the role:
The cybersecurity team at FYUL is deliberately small and execution-focused. Its engineering branch runs the company's security operations backbone: a large-scale telemetry and detection platform covering endpoints, network traffic, cloud workloads, and SaaS - a modern SIEM at its core, extended with substantial custom machine learning and AI agents that this team designs and builds itself. This senior engineer role, reporting directly to the Information Security Engineering Manager, owns significant parts of that platform: detection engineering, vulnerability discovery, cloud and endpoint security, data loss prevention, and the automation of security operations.
This is an individual-contributor position where professional growth comes from depth of expertise and ownership of outcomes. The security program is mature, with governance and compliance handled by a dedicated GRC function - so this role is about building and running security engineering, full-time.
Your daily tasks will include:

• Detection engineering. Design, implement, and tune detections across our security telemetry - SIEM rules as well as custom ML models for anomaly and risk detection. Triage alerts, investigate real incidents, and drive them to closure - including technical incident response and post-incident improvement.

• Cloud and platform security. Harden and monitor our AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) environments: workload security, IAM, container runtime defense, and configuration standards. Collaborate with engineering teams so security lands as enablement, not friction.

• Endpoint security. Own the health and hardening of the endpoint agent fleet across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

• Security automation. Automate recurring operations and detection-to-response workflows - including AI-based agents and pipelines, which are already a working part of this program. Prefer integrating established tooling over bespoke development where it delivers the same outcome.

• Vulnerability discovery and management. Find infrastructure vulnerabilities yourself - through scanning, configuration review, and targeted penetration testing of our environments - then prioritize and drive remediation to closure. This is not an application security role: a dedicated sub-team covers appsec.

Your qualifications:

• 5+ years in security engineering or SecOps roles with hands-on responsibility for detections and incidents in production - not solely policy or advisory work.

• Real detection engineering experience on a modern SIEM/security platform (Elastic Security preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, or comparable count), and the appetite to go beyond built-in rules into custom ML-based detection.

• Deep, hands-on mastery of Linux, macOS, and Windows: internals, hardening, and investigation on all three. You have personally hunted or hardened systems on each of them, not just one favorite.

• Strong networking expertise: TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and packet-level analysis - you can reconstruct what happened from a packet capture and reason about how traffic actually flows through our environments.

• Strong cloud security foundation in AWS, including Kubernetes; you have personally secured and monitored production cloud workloads.

• Hands-on LLM experience. You have built or operated LLM-powered tooling - agents, pipelines, or detection/automation workflows - not merely used a chat assistant. Our security program already runs AI agents in production; you will extend that work.

• A certification in practical infrastructure hacking or hardening - e.g., OSCP, OSEP, or a comparable hands-on offensive credential. This matters more to us than knowledge-exam certifications.

Great people, bold ideas, and a sharp focus on user experience set us apart.
Purpose
We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer with an analytical mindset and a product-oriented perspective to join our multidisciplinary teams. At BetWarrior , we are evolving toward a Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and Given-When-Then / Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) model.
We are not simply looking for a developer who turns designs into code, but rather an engineer who takes end-to-end ownership of the problem: from refining and technically specifying requirements (state diagrams, API contracts, Markdown/Gherkin specs) to delivering robust and scalable solutions.
In this role, you'll

• Lead technical analysis based on initial Product/UX Acceptance Criteria. Define sequence/state diagrams, API contracts, and write functional specifications (MD/Gherkin) before writing code.

• Model complex state flows and design resilient interface architectures capable of operating in high-traffic, low-latency environments.

• Work closely with Product and UX teams in small, autonomous squads, acting as the technical bridge between business ideas and viable architectures.

• Translate business scenarios into clear acceptance criteria and well-structured system behaviors, actively collaborating with the Automation QA team.

• Design components and abstractions with long-term maintainability in mind, anticipating edge cases, critical bugs, and bottlenecks

What we look for in an exceptional candidate

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, providing the foundation needed to have worked through the level of complexity required for problem-solving.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience managing critical state flows in web applications or concurrent platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to create technical documentation prior to development (OpenAPI/Swagger specs, UML/sequence diagrams, Markdown technical specs).

• Familiarity with defining business-oriented scenarios using Given-When-Then / Gherkin.

• Strong foundations in computer science or software engineering (design patterns, data structures, browser performance), beyond narrow expertise in a particular library.

• Experience or working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, UI libraries/frameworks such as React, and Node.js environments.

Bonus points if you also have

• Experience working on high-traffic, high-concurrency, or real-time data platforms.

• Experience going through complex production incidents or post-mortems that have shaped your approach to preventing errors through clear specifications.

• Knowledge of event-driven architecture or real-time API technologies (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events)

How we do things
BetWarrior is a company in expansion. The team is fast-moving, collaborative, and demanding - with high standards for quality and a genuine commitment to building something that lasts. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for people who want to grow with the company, take ownership of their work, and be part of building a regional team that operates at a high level across multiple markets.
For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at a stage where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and the path forward is defined by what you deliver - not by time in role.
We expect every team member to live our values
Accountability & Ownership -Take charge, own your craft
Reliability -Deliver with quality and consistency
Teamwork -Collaborate, challenge, and grow together
Winner Spirit -Compete with purpose and grit
